message: Coredrift: yellow (hardening_in_core) | next: Move guardrails/fallbacks into a harden follow-up task

Drift note: hardening_in_core warning is from the intentional direct-image fallback. Normal organizer HTML includes revisioned image URLs and uses cached snapshots without redownload; if a revisioned image URL is requested before cache warmup, API downloads once and verifies the revision rather than serving a wrong image. Verification: uv run pytest -q -> 298 passed, 4 deselected.

Implemented revision-aware local snapshot reuse for organizer thumbnails. Live tailnet smoke: /organizer and /organizer?notebook=Quick return 200; sample revisioned thumbnail returns 200 image/png with Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable. Full pytest suite passed: 298 passed, 4 deselected.
